blocks.text: Filipino boxer Junmilardo Ogayre edged Mongolia’s Lundaa Gantumur via split decision, 3-2, for a winning debut in the men’s 60kg boxing preliminaries of the 2026 Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games on Wednesday at Nishio Gymnasium in Japan.
